_note: SHIELD IMPACTS. Mike, 2026-09-12: 'generate me proper 16-bit shield impact noises'.
The shipped shield_hit_light.wav peaks at 68% of its own length - the transient arrives
two thirds of the way in, which is the same 'delayed' defect CLAUDE.md already records for
reviewed_shadow_orb_launch.wav. Measured by sfx_gen.py audit, not guessed.
Every prompt below names the ERA and the DRYNESS explicitly, because ElevenLabs defaults to
cinematic sound design - a swell, a long tail, and a beat of silence first. The post-process
in sfx_gen.py band-limits and cuts the tail on top of that; the prompt is only half the job.
Ordered light -> heavy -> break so the set reads as one family under fire.

sounds.prompt: Instant short metallic energy shield deflect. A hard bright ping on the very first millisecond, like a bullet skipping off an electrified plate, then a quick descending synthetic shimmer. Dry, no reverb, no room tone, no music. Retro arcade video game sound effect, punchy and clipped.

Heavy impact on an energy barrier. A deep thudding slam at the very start with a bright electric crack layered on top, then a short buzzing electrical wobble that dies fast. Dry and close, no reverb tail, no music. Retro 16-bit arcade video game hit sound, thick and punchy.

An energy shield shattering and failing. Sharp glassy crack immediately, then collapsing electrical fizz and a falling synthetic tone as the field dies out. Dry, arcade, no reverb, no music. Retro video game shield destroyed sound effect.

An energy shield snapping on. A fast rising electric whoosh that locks into a clean sustained hum, bright and synthetic. Quick, dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game power-up barrier sound.
A very short electric tick, a single small spark against a force field. Tiny, bright, instant, gone. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game blip.

A warning that a shield is nearly gone. Two quick descending electronic tones with a faint unstable crackle underneath, urgent but not shrill. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game low energy alert.
